name: Kawase Ritsuto
source:
One of the Hakkenshi, he holds the mark of 'justice' on his body.
He hates socializing with other people and only talks when absolutely necessary.
He doesn't trust other people and always has to settle things by himself.
He always thinking of the worst case scenarios.
